plan.scope: Confirmation-only fixed compiler rewrite; metadata-restricted fresh exact model families, not architecture-disjoint and not native PassBench acceptance
plan.compiler_comparison: Separate isolated compiler checkouts; all production compilation source files pinned; only tensor.js differs. Identical current importer-generated programs and measurement runtime for both variants.
plan.inputs: Original source replay, no input mutation, complete output structure
plan.order: Seeded shuffled order of exact distinct executable fingerprints per graph/repeat; aliases share measurements
plan.failure_policy: Retain every selected graph and every compile/reference/correctness/timing failure; any failure disables an aggregate speedup claim; no replacement or outcome-based eligibility
plan.selection: No training, ranking or tuning; both source variants fixed before any selected graph is compiled
metrics: CUDA-event stream elapsed ms including dispatch gaps
plan.primary_summary: Exact-model family-balanced geometric mean baseline/candidate median ratio; repeated timings are descriptive, not a calibrated confidence interval
plan.declaration_status: Finalized before confirmation source scanning or compilation

prior_selection_attempt.result: Incomplete 19 of 20 metadata-selected families; no compilation, artifact inspection or GPU timing

plan.metadata_retry_policy: May reuse first-attempt metadata-only selections; these are not independent confirmations. All evaluation models and previously selected prior policy-study models remain excluded; fixed compiler sources and all measurement rules unchanged.
